clue.text: Developing adoration about French wine and golf

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word for adoration is written backwards

parts.note: adoration means love
vin is the French word for wine
G is golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A growing passion for French wine and a round of golf.
explanation.definitionFit: Something evolving is gradually changing and growing, which is what developing means.

clue.text: Italian city uprising stopped by a leader

indicators.note: stopped by means plugged in the middle by another piece, which goes inside
uprising in a down clue means the city's name is read from bottom to top

parts.note: Rome is the Italian capital
a means per, as in 'a pound a day'

explanation.surface: A revolt in an Italian city is halted by a single leader.
explanation.walkthrough: 'uprising' turns ROME into EMOR, and 'a' gives PER (as in 'so much a day'), which goes into it.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor is the supreme ruler of an empire, so the head of state, a leader.

clue.text: Lecture's nothing to value

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O
to rate something is to value it

explanation.surface: A talk claiming that nothing has any value.
explanation.definitionFit: To orate is to speak at length formally, which is what a lecturing speaker does.

clue.text: Very strangely end civility in spiteful manner

indicators.note: strangely means the letters are set out in an odd new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A complaint that politeness has come to a very strange end.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting vindictively means seeking revenge out of malice, which is behaving spitefully.

clue.text: Negative responses about society features

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the responses go round the other letter

parts.note: noes are negative answers

explanation.surface: People refusing to answer questions about society features.
explanation.walkthrough: 'features' is used in the sense of parts of the face.
explanation.definitionFit: Facial features are the parts of the face, and the nose is one of them.

clue.text: Nasty smell socks discharged is to dominate

parts.note: BO is body odour

indicators.note: discharged means emptied, so only the outer letters of the word stay

parts.note: the first and last letters of socks

explanation.surface: The smell of worn socks is so strong it dominates the room.
explanation.definitionFit: To boss people is to order them about, to take control over them.

clue.text: Take bulbous vegetable cut by Greek character

indicators.note: cut by means another piece slices into the middle, so it is placed inside

parts.note: an onion is a vegetable that grows as a bulb
pi is a letter of the Greek alphabet

explanation.surface: A cookery instruction: take an onion and chop it with a Greek knife.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Take' reads like a recipe verb, but it is a noun: someone's take on a matter.
explanation.definitionFit: Your take on something is your view of it, your personal opinion.

clue.text: Child in class progressing

indicators.note: in means the answer sits inside the run of letters that follows

parts.note: the letters run across the two words: letters 5-9 of 'class progressing'

explanation.surface: A pupil doing well at school.
explanation.walkthrough: Sprog is British slang for a child.
explanation.definitionFit: Sprog is informal British slang for a youngster or offspring.

clue.text: Crucial worker supporting a factory set up on harbour

indicators.note: on in a down clue means sitting above, so these letters come before the next piece
supporting in a down clue means placed underneath, so it comes last
set up in a down clue means the word is turned upside down, so read backwards

parts.note: a mill is a factory
a port is a harbour
the worker ant is the crossword's favourite worker

explanation.surface: A key employee keeps a dockside factory running.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'on' puts A and the upturned MILL above PORT, and 'supporting' puts ANT underneath everything.
explanation.definitionFit: Something all-important matters more than anything else, so it is vital.

clue.text: Simple aircraft, reportedly

indicators.note: reportedly means as it is said out loud, so a word sounding the same

parts.note: a plane is an aircraft

explanation.surface: A basic flying machine, so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: Plain means unadorned and straightforward, so simple.

clue.text: Comparatively smooth type that is welcomed by senior

indicators.note: welcomed by means taken in by the next piece, which goes round

parts.note: ilk means type or kind
IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A certain kind of person is greeted warmly by an older one.
explanation.definitionFit: Silkier is the comparative of silky, meaning softer and smoother like silk.

clue.text: Deer groomed regularly

indicators.note: regularly means taking every other letter of the following word

parts.note: the second, fourth and sixth letters of groomed are taken

explanation.surface: A deer that is brushed down at frequent intervals.
explanation.definitionFit: The roe is a small species of deer native to Europe.

clue.text: Stimulating and popular group of secret agents, we're told

parts.note: in means fashionable, popular

indicators.note: we're told means heard aloud, so these letters sound like the phrase

parts.note: a spy ring is a network of spies

explanation.surface: A thrilling and well-liked spy network, or so people say.
explanation.definitionFit: Something inspiring rouses people and fills them with enthusiasm, so it is stimulating.

clue.text: Refund on returned electronic tablet

parts.note: re means on, concerning

indicators.note: returned means sent back, so the letters are read in reverse

parts.note: E is the abbreviation for electronic, as in email
a tab is a tablet or pill

explanation.surface: Getting your money back on an electronic tablet you returned.
explanation.definitionFit: A rebate is money given back, a partial return of a payment.

clue.text: Waiting to get new cover for book

indicators.note: to get means receive in, so the other letter is placed inside

parts.note: biding means waiting, as in biding one's time

explanation.surface: Waiting for a new jacket for a book.
explanation.definitionFit: A book's binding is its covers and spine, which hold the pages together.

clue.text: Love to write ER's first episode

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
to pen is to write
ER is taken as written

explanation.surface: A writer would love to script the debut instalment of the hospital drama ER.
explanation.walkthrough: ER here is just the letters; the surface makes it the US television series.
explanation.definitionFit: The opener of a television series is the episode that starts it off.

clue.text: Alleged grass retains position

indicators.note: retains means holds inside, so the other piece is placed within

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass
to put something is to position it

explanation.surface: A supposed informer keeps his job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grass' looks like an informer here, but it is the plant.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reputed is said or believed to be so, which is what alleged means.

clue.text: One overhauls tank in Nevada city with soldiers

parts.note: Reno is a city in Nevada
a vat is a large tank for liquids
OR is other ranks, ordinary soldiers

explanation.surface: A man repairing a water tank in a Nevada town alongside some soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: A renovator restores old buildings or objects to good condition, giving them a refit.

clue.text: King and kids avoiding motorway services

parts.note: R is rex, Latin for king

indicators.note: avoiding means keeping clear of, so this letter is dropped

parts.note: mites are small children
M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: A royal family steering clear of a motorway service station.
explanation.walkthrough: 'services' suggests a motorway service area; it means church ceremonies.
explanation.definitionFit: Rites are religious ceremonies, the formal acts of worship in a service.

clue.text: Tropical fish both sides of the craft going north

indicators.note: both sides of means only the first and last letters of the next word

parts.note: the outer letters of the

indicators.note: going north in a down clue means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: art is craft or skill

explanation.surface: Fish swimming either side of a boat heading northwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Tetras are small, brightly coloured freshwater fish from tropical rivers, popular in aquariums.

clue.text: Element of cappuccino on counter?

indicators.note: counter here suggests anticlockwise, against the direction of reading, so the letters go backwards
Element of means a run of letters taken from inside the word

parts.note: the fifth to seventh letters

explanation.surface: Part of the coffee served on a café counter.
explanation.walkthrough: The letters PUC sit inside 'cappuccino', and reading them backwards gives the answer; the whole clue also describes what holds the coffee.
explanation.definitionFit: A cappuccino is served in a cup, placed on the counter, so the vessel is part of the drink.

clue.text: Church of Ireland ignoring female vocal group

indicators.note: ignoring means leaving out, so this letter is dropped

explanation.surface: An Irish church shutting women out of its singing group.
explanation.definitionFit: A choir is an organised group of singers, often in a church.

clue.text: Person with siblings allowed on outing

indicators.note: on means coming after, so this piece follows the other

parts.note: a trip is an outing
let means allowed

explanation.surface: Someone with brothers and sisters given permission to go on an excursion.
explanation.definitionFit: A triplet is one of three born at one birth, so has at least two siblings the same age.

clue.text: Choose personal trainer following fuss

indicators.note: following means coming after, so this piece goes second

parts.note: ado is fuss, as in much ado about nothing
PT is the abbreviation for physical training, and for a personal trainer

explanation.surface: Picking a fitness coach after a lot of fuss.
explanation.definitionFit: To adopt an option is to take it up as one's own, to select it.

clue.text: Son to get older wise person

parts.note: to age is to get older

explanation.surface: A boy has to grow up to become wise.
explanation.definitionFit: A sage is someone of great learning and judgment, a profoundly wise figure.

clue.text: Rum crated up and secured

indicators.note: rum means strange or odd, so the letters are put in an odd new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Bottles of rum are boxed up and made safe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Rum' looks like the drink being crated, but it is the old word for odd.
explanation.definitionFit: To capture something is to take hold of it and secure it.
